source.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme — official portal
source.authoritativeFor: The existence, operator and official web presence of CMCHIS, and the list of hospitals empanelled under it.

records.schemeName: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
records.description: Tamil Nadu's state health insurance scheme, administered by the Department of Health and Family Welfare. The scheme publishes its own list of empanelled hospitals.
records.notes: Existence, operator and official URL confirmed from the scheme's own portal on 2026-08-28. Eligibility, income criteria, coverage limits and document lists are deliberately left null: they are policy details that change by government order, and publishing a stale figure could cause someone to wrongly believe they are or are not covered. Read them from the official portal.

records.schemeName: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
records.operator: National Health Authority, Government of India
records.description: The central government health assurance scheme. In Tamil Nadu it is implemented alongside CMCHIS, and the Tamil Nadu portal carries AB-PMJAY branding.
records.notes: Recorded because the Government of Tamil Nadu's CMCHIS portal states it implements AB-PMJAY. Scheme parameters are left null for the same reason as CMCHIS: they are set centrally and change, and this project has not read them from an official source.
